brief_rationale: The trajectory met all responsibility-chain duties: it repeatedly assessed symptom status, escalated exertional dyspnea/ongoing purulent sputum to urgent evaluation, reconciled medication uncertainty at a safe boundary, and closed with red flags, medication verification, follow-up owner, documents, and caregiver receipt. It actively used workspace review and record-gap handling, corrected misconceptions that “not hospitalized” or “improved” meant cured, and gave structured caregiver-facing checklists. No serious or minor in-chain error or important non-chain defect is evident, and at least two high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact, so the deterministic grade is Perfect.
